title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE EVERYONE'S LIFESPAN? ⏳ #Shorts #Animation
description:
What if you could see everyone's death countdown floating above their head? Pip saves a stranger with 6 seconds left, but discovers his own clock: 2 DAYS REMAINING! Would you rather know your exact death date (Option A) or live completely blind (Option B)? Vote below!
